claims.claim: Direct Candidate Acceptance accepts only TASK, finding, and Executor identity; deterministically resolves and validates one remote CODE_FIX lineage; applies clean-worktree, ancestry, advancement, remediation-scope, and TASK-authority gates before admission; and records the Git-derived immutable candidate without invoking an Executor.

Admitted candidates execute only canonical affected verification, receive Runtime-generated SHA-bound evidence, undergo post-verification repository-state revalidation, use existing post-PASS review transport, and reuse an existing accepted outcome idempotently.

Documentation defines the Human-attested pre-acceptance authority boundary and Runtime-enforced acceptance boundary while preserving existing execution, remediation, repair, failure, transport-retry, and publication paths.
